events.title: Golden Jubilee National Law Conference 2026
events.description: Marking 50 years of the Colombo Law Society charter (1975–2025) as the premier branch association of the BASL. Deliberations on judicial independence, modernizing civil procedures, and cross-border commercial arbitration.

events.title: Hulftsdorp Junior Bar Advocacy & Trial Ethics Colloquium
events.description: Hands-on cross-examination techniques, appellate briefs drafting, and courtroom decorum for junior practitioners entering Colombo chambers.

events.title: Executive Working Council Monthly Deliberations
events.description: Monthly council review on Hulftsdorp courtroom infrastructure, welfare endowments, and BASL national council liaison.

gallery.title: 50th Golden Jubilee Commemoration & Law Conference
gallery.venue: Main Auditorium, Superior Courts Complex, Hulftsdorp
gallery.description: Inaugural plenary session addressed by the Supreme Court bench and executive officers of the Colombo Law Society.

gallery.title: Opening of the Legal Year Ceremonial Assembly
gallery.description: Annual traditional procession of the Colombo Bar welcoming new practitioners and honoring senior advocates of over 50 years standing.

gallery.title: Annual Law Dinner & Bar Excellence Awards Gala
gallery.venue: The Grand Ballroom, Galle Face Hotel, Colombo
gallery.description: Gala evening celebrating bar milestones with attendance of judicial officers, legal luminaries, and foreign delegates.

gallery.title: Constitution Day Colloquium & Public Law Review
gallery.description: Symposium on constitutional guarantees, fundamental rights adjudication, and judicial independence in South Asia.

gallery.title: Junior Bar Robing & Professional Induction Seminar
gallery.description: Intensive advocacy workshop and ethics induction for newly admitted Attorneys-at-Law entering Colombo chambers.

gallery.title: Golden Jubilee Charter Commemoration Ceremony
gallery.description: Celebrating 50 years as the premier branch association of the Bar Association of Sri Lanka.
